answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making trust grow slowly, like a lotus rising from mud: a new identity starts with zero reputation and must earn it through verified completed work, with payment held in escrow until delivery is confirmed. A comet burst of fresh accounts cannot fake that history, because each job adds a signed record tied to stake that vests over time. Splitting stake across many fake identities only dilutes each one, like footprints scattered across a dune — visible, shallow, and worth nothing on their own.
